reviews.text: Great staff, very helpful with new products and bargains for your pet
Staff was very helpful in choosing needed items
This is a great store. The people are lovely, and really care about pets.  Great range of products and good pricing.

Pretty sure it's always the best price for the dog food we get, or at least the same as other places that never run offers. They also have a stamp card and rewards program, so our next bag is free, which is fantastic and not something I've seen anywhere else. Shop is clean, well stocked and laid out, staff are nice. Pity the Finglas store closed, but Blanch is as close to us and they do online orders.
The person responsible for the order is incorrect. I've been waiting 10 weeks for my wet dog food to be delivered and it still hasn't arrive
Great range with fair prices and friendly staff,

Over a year ago we rescued a Newfoundland who really was not well. His diet and supplements were a key factor in his recovery and keeping him well. All the staff at Pet Food depot Coolmine really could not do enough in recommending the right foods and supplements. Their extensive knowledge on their products is commendable. Anna in particular was able to advise on similar skin issues that she herself had dealt with. I was able to put this advice into practice with “Opie” and it made a huge improvement. Just recently Stephen and Anna went above and beyond when I came to buy Opies food. Unfortunately it was not in stock, knowing that Opie needs this particular food Stephen rang the Finglas store and managed to secure 2 bags for me. Not only that, he drove to Finglas picked up the food and had it ready for me the next day! Honestly I have never experienced customer service like it!!! It was very much appreciated and I would recommend Pet Food Depot Coolmine to anyone. A special thanks to Anna and Stephen 😊
All you need is there along with helpful staff
Nice shop, staff are friendly. A bit expensive though and I'm on a customer loyalty plan where I've seen absolutely no benefit whatsoever in 2+ years.

Great service, staff members are super helpful. Carried all my shopping to the car ;) And notified about the latest offers and savings.
